thread:
elaine: Heads-up — intermittent issue: edge proxy sometimes leaves SSE handshake half-closed after client reconnect, creating duplicate backend sessions and bumping tenant quotas.

elaine: Observed pattern: client retries quickly, proxy socket in CLOSE_WAIT ~20-40s, backend accepts second session with same resume token, both counted.

mike: any trace samples? need seq of events + tokens.

elaine: i captured a trace sample, but sampling hides most cases. snippet below:
```
client -> proxy (SSE CONNECT) X-Resume-Token: abc123
proxy -> backend: CreateSession(token_hash=sha256(abc123))
proxy socket enters CLOSE_WAIT
client retries -> proxy (SSE CONNECT) same token
proxy opens new backend session -> duplicate count
```

sana: sampling is 1% right now for streaming. can we tag these as `stream_handshake_linger` and force-sample those flows?

oliver: i want a metric too: per-tenant `resume_token_duplicate_attempts` and a dedupe-rate gauge. Console should show it in per-route observability.

mike: is this proxy not closing sockets properly, or backend logic creating new sessions prematurely?

elaine: hypothesis: TLS rekey / half-close edge case leaves OS socket state lingering. proxy's connection lifecycle doesn't GC quickly. backend defensively creates new session if it sees a CONNECT with resume token.

oliver: short-term mitigation: routing layer dedupe window for identical resume tokens — e.g., ignore new connects for same token within 60s (behind a runtime flag). avoids double-charging. downside: might mask legitimate reconnects.

sana: proposed rollout plan: 1) add `stream_handshake_linger` diagnostic tag + force-sample; 2) emit metric `resume_token_duplicate_attempt` per-tenant; 3) add console alert when rate exceeds threshold (0.1% of sessions).

mike: also capture `tcp_state` and `socket_age_ms` when we force-sample to aid root cause.

elaine: i'll drop a tiny proxy patch to set the tag and export socket state. will hash resume tokens in logs (sha256) to avoid PII.

oliver: console UX: add a streaming reliability card in per-route view showing dedupe rate, avg linger, and clickable trace snippets for forced-sampled sessions.

analytics-bot: note: forced sampling will increase trace ingestion. estimate +2-3% TTI for 48h if enabled globally. target per-tenant forced sampling to limit cost.

mike: good call. only enable forced sampling for tenants with >3 duplicates in rolling 10m window. that keeps scope narrow.

sana: i'll update the dashboard JSON and add an anomaly alert panel. will not change billing metrics queries.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy/agent@rev-a1b2c -> staging (ETA ~5m).

elaine: PR checklist: include readme for on-call steps to flip per-tenant forced sampling and to disable dedupe-window runtime flag. also ensure token hashing in traces.

oliver: add runbook snippet: how to revert dedupe flag if customers report missed reconnects. include telemetry thresholds to watch.

mike: long-term: fix proxy half-close lifecycle. short-term: leave dedupe off by default, enable per-tenant when we see spikes.

sana: i'll ping when dashboard is live and add links to runbook. :white_check_mark:

elaine: thanks all — i'm going to monitor staging after deploy and post back with initial numbers.
